data.name: Ultimate Loot Editor
data.teaser: An in depth in raid loose loot editor
data.description:
Ultimate Loot Editor

Ultimate Loot Editor is an in raid loose loot editor. It lets you visualize loose loot spawn points, inspect what can spawn there, adjust spawn chances and item weights, and add or remove items.

Features

  • View loose loot spawn points in raid as spheres.
  • Open a spawn point editor while standing and looking at a sphere.
  • Edit spawn chance.
  • Add or remove possible loot items.
  • Change individual item weights.
  • Compare edited loot against vanilla loot.
  • Revert a spawn point back to vanilla.
  • Edit supported items such as weapons, armor, and helmets.
  • Automatically handles compatible ammo for magazines/weapons.
  • Saves map edits as JSON files that can be shared or manually edited.
  • Supports modded items, weapons, armor, and helmets.

How to use

I recommend you configure the raid to disable AI first. Once in raid, the default bind is F9 to enable the visualization of spawn points. Find a spawn point you want to edit, and press Mouse button 4 by default to open the editor. The binds and the UI can be changed in the F12 menu. Once you have made the changes that you want to spawn points, you can extract and requeue into the map, there is no need to close the game for the spawn changes to take effect.
data.custom_ai_disclosure: I’ve been trying to learn code while working on and making this project, I have done my best to ensure there is no impact to the quality. AI was used to help me with most of the code, as well as helping me with class names.

versions.description:
### Added
- Added support for creating new loose loot spawn points in raid.
- Added spawn point naming for newly created spawn points.
- Added position and rotation fields for custom spawn placement and fine tuning.
- Added in world item previewing at a spawn point.
- Added a gravity toggle for spawn points, useful for specific item placement.
- Added copy, paste, and replace actions for spawn point loot data.
- Added keyboard shortcuts for save, copy, paste, undo, and redo while the editor is open.
- Added native EFT notifications for copy, paste, replace, save, undo, and redo.
- Added F12 options for editor notifications and click-drag numeric value editing.

### Changed
- Removed the IMGUI version of the editor.

### Fixed
- Fixed created spawn points not reopening correctly before saving.
- Fixed newly added loot sometimes not spawning correctly.
- Fixed several placement UI alignment issues.
- Fixed save stutter when saving repeatedly.
- Improved editor save performance.
- Improved spawn placement controls.
- Improved item preview behavior.

### Fixed
- Fixed sphere visualization name tags appearing over EFT UI, including the pause menu and editor UI.
- Fixed item sorting across multiple pages. Spawn entries now sort by weight correctly across the full list, not separately per page.
- Fixed some item names/TPL text drawing outside the middle content area while scrolling large spawn point lists.
- Fixed some icons randomly not appearing in large spawn point lists.

### Improved
- Reduced the stutter when opening the spawn editor for the first time.
- Reduced stutter when opening different spawn points.
- Improved scrolling performance for spawn points with large item lists.
- Improved row virtualization so large spawn tables use fewer active UI rows.
- Improved editor resize performance.
- Updated spawn point navigation text from `1/2` to `Spawn 1/2`.
Initial release, please let me know if you run into any issues.
